faq.a: Because chess is a motor-spatial reflex skill, not a lecture. When you watch video, you engage passive auditory memory. When you touch the board and make interactive decisions with immediate feedback, your brain forms spatial muscle memory 5x faster.

faq.q: What if my opponent plays weird opening moves?
faq.a: That's exactly why traditional opening courses fail. Our course doesn't teach memorized opening lines—it teaches invariant survival principles: checking piece safety, king defense, and spotting forks regardless of what strange moves your opponent plays.

faq.q: Is this suitable if I'm rated 500 Elo?
faq.a: 500 Elo is the exact sweet spot. If you know the basic moves of chess but constantly lose games to sudden blunders, this course was engineered specifically for you.
